Aurora PostgreSQL with express configuration now supported in CloudFormation
changes.detail: Aurora PostgreSQL now supports express configuration in AWS CloudFormation for infrastructure as code deployment. This launch enables you to automate the infrastructure deployment of your Aurora clusters through CloudFormation templates while benefiting from the speed of express configuration. Aurora PostgreSQL clusters created with express configuration allow you to create and query an Aurora serverless database in seconds. changes.title: AWS Secrets Manager now supports cross-account replication
changes.detail: AWS Secrets Manager now supports cross-account replication, enabling you to maintain a synchronized copy of a primary secret in a secondary AWS account for cross-account access, backup, and disaster recovery. Cross-account replication extends the existing multi-Region replication capability across account boundaries. With cross-account replication, platform or security teams can own and rotate a secret centrally, and each consuming account gets a local, always-current copy without any shared KMS keys or cross-account secret policies.
